_note: Candidate on-site checks. Each outcome says which hypotheses it supports or argues against. Costs are minutes on site. 'applies_when' limits a check to cases where it makes physical sense.

checks.label: Check the drip line and valve on the {edge} edge

wet.label: Drip line working
wet.then: counts against irrigation failure; look at the leaf undersides for thrips and mildew

checks.label: Dig 10 cm in the affected zone and feel the soil

dry.label: Soil dry
dry.then: points to a water supply problem

moist.label: Soil moist
moist.then: water is reaching the roots, so look for pests or nutrients

checks.label: Photograph leaf undersides in the affected patch

pests_or_lesions.label: Pests or lesions visible
pests_or_lesions.then: points to pest or disease spread

clean.label: Leaves clean
clean.then: rules out the common leaf pests; look at water and nutrients

checks.label: Note which leaves are yellowing, old or new
Look for standing water and check how wet the soil is

standing.label: Standing water
standing.then: points to flooding or waterlogging (irrigation timing or drainage)

none.label: No standing water
none.then: rules out ponding; look at the crop itself

visit_checklist: Walk the affected zones and note what looks different from the rest of the plot.
Check the water supply: drip lines, valves, pump and the soil at 10 cm.
Look at leaf undersides for pests, webbing or lesions.
Ask the farmer what changed in the last two weeks: water, sprays, labour.

visit.label: Call the farmer or visit the field

harvested.label: Crop was harvested
harvested.then: explains the drop as a harvest

pruned.label: Vines were pruned
pruned.then: explains the drop as fruit pruning

pests.label: Pests or disease seen
pests.then: points to pest or disease spread
